units.source_text: 发表这篇日记的时候，我写了一篇“后记”。

en.t: When I published this diary, I wrote an afterword.

units.source_text: 关于这篇日记，要作的说明在那篇后记里大体都谈到了。

en.t: The explanations that needed to be made about this diary were mostly covered in that afterword.

units.source_text: 不过后记是以小说形式写成，有些地方与事实多少有些出入。

en.t: However, the afterword was written in the form of a story, and in some places it differs somewhat from the facts.

units.source_text: 小说有一处写道：“我的舅舅最近破产，连房屋地产都失去了。”

en.t: At one point the story says, "My uncle recently went bankrupt and even lost his house and land."

units.source_text: 其实卖掉房屋地产的，是我的表哥。

en.t: In fact, the person who sold the house and land was my cousin.

units.source_text: 是在我舅舅死后才卖掉的。

en.t: They were sold only after my uncle had died.

units.source_text: 舅舅是个谨小慎微的正直人。

en.t: My uncle was a cautious, upright man.

units.source_text: 另外写了在父亲出诊的皮包里塞满了我少年时代的日记，也有点夸大其词。

en.t: It was also somewhat exaggerated to write that my boyhood diaries filled the bag my father used for medical house calls.

units.source_text: 这些中学时代的日记，现在也基本上保存下来了，但不是很多。

en.t: These diaries from my middle school days have largely been preserved even now, but there are not very many of them.
